RECOVERY_DEGRADED.message: Recovery completed with warnings; historical Sessions remain available.
RECOVERY_DEGRADED.remediation: Review the recovery details before starting a new capture.

CORE_NOT_TRAFFIC_TRACER.message: The running core does not provide TrafficTracer capabilities.
CORE_NOT_TRAFFIC_TRACER.remediation: Select verge-mihomo-tt and restart the proxy core.

CORE_ENDPOINT_MISSING.message: No Mihomo controller endpoint is configured.
CORE_ENDPOINT_MISSING.remediation: Select the TrafficTracer core and configure its controller endpoint.

CORE_TRACING_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Start mihomo-traffictracer and verify the controller endpoint and secret.

CORE_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH.message: The selected core does not advertise normalized Flow support.
CORE_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH.remediation: Select the verge-mihomo-tt core built from the pinned TrafficTracer branch.

TUN_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.message: TUN mode is enabled, but the Clash Verge service is unavailable.
TUN_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Install or repair the Clash Verge TUN service, then check again.

TUN_DISABLED.message: TUN mode is disabled; proxy-flow capture may be incomplete.
TUN_DISABLED.remediation: Enable TUN mode before starting a full TrafficTracer capture.

TUN_INTERFACE_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: The TUN capture interface is not configured.
TUN_INTERFACE_NOT_CONFIGURED.remediation: Select the TUN interface in the capture settings.

TUN_INTERFACE_ENUMERATION_FAILED.message: Network interfaces could not be enumerated.
TUN_INTERFACE_ENUMERATION_FAILED.remediation: Check operating-system network permissions and try again.

TUN_INTERFACE_NOT_FOUND.message: The selected TUN interface does not exist.

PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: The physical capture interface is not configured.
PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_NOT_CONFIGURED.remediation: Select the physical interface in the capture settings.

PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_ENUMERATION_FAILED.message: Network interfaces could not be enumerated.
PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_ENUMERATION_FAILED.remediation: Check operating-system network permissions and try again.

PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_NOT_FOUND.message: The selected physical interface does not exist.
PHYSICAL_INTERFACE_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Refresh interfaces after reconnecting the network.

CAPTURE_TOOL_NOT_FOUND.message: tshark and dumpcap are required for packet capture.
CAPTURE_TOOL_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Install Wireshark CLI tools and add tshark and dumpcap to PATH.

CAPTURE_TOOL_CHECK_FAILED.remediation: Verify the dumpcap executable and its Linux capabilities.

CAPTURE_PERMISSION_DENIED.remediation: Grant dumpcap capture capabilities or add the user to the wireshark group.

CAPTURE_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Run dumpcap -D in a terminal and fix the reported error.

CHROME_NOT_EXECUTABLE.message: The configured Chrome or Chromium executable is unavailable.
CHROME_NOT_EXECUTABLE.remediation: Select an executable Chrome or Chromium binary.

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MISSING.remediation: Choose an absolute directory for TrafficTracer Sessions.

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_NOT_ABSOLUTE.message: The output directory must be an absolute path.
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_NOT_ABSOLUTE.remediation: Choose the output directory with the folder picker.

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_INVALID.message: The configured output path is not a directory.
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_INVALID.remediation: Choose a directory instead of a file.

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_NOT_WRITABLE.message: The output directory cannot be created or written.
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_NOT_WRITABLE.remediation: Choose a writable directory or correct its permissions.

OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_WILL_CREATE.message: The output directory does not exist yet and will be created.
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_WILL_CREATE.remediation: No action is required, or create it now to verify permissions.

DISK_THRESHOLD_INVALID.message: The minimum free-space threshold is invalid.
DISK_THRESHOLD_INVALID.remediation: Configure a non-negative minimum free-space threshold.

DISK_SPACE_UNAVAILABLE.message: Free disk space could not be inspected.
DISK_SPACE_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Choose an output directory on an accessible mounted filesystem.

DISK_SPACE_LOW.message: The output filesystem does not have enough free space.
DISK_SPACE_LOW.remediation: Free disk space or choose a different output directory.
